quotes.text: The gospel or a heavenly message came to Jacob when he was in awful peril from his brother Esau. The Lord came to him at this tritical moment and blessed him. And he testifies that he had seen the Lord face to face. Lot received a visit from two angels, who informed him of the necessity of removing his family and friends immediately in order to escape destruction.
